events.summary: An IRGC spokesperson said Iran and Oman had reached agreements on Hormuz control and revenue sharing, while AP described the arrangement as an evolving/potential deal with temporary routes and later permanent terms.
events.observed_fact: Reuters reported the IRGC spokesperson's claim of agreements on control/revenues; AP independently reported Iran's military-vessel-ban position and described the broader Oman arrangement as still evolving.
events.claimed_effect: Iran presents the talks as having produced agreed control and revenue-sharing terms.
events.verified_effect: The public record establishes movement in the Iran-Oman Hormuz framework but does not independently establish that every control/revenue term is jointly finalized and implemented.
events.counterevidence: AP's characterization of the arrangement as evolving/potential constrains the stronger Iranian finality claim.
events.continuity_evidence: Extends the Aug. 25 temporary-corridor and mine-clearing framework without rewriting its earlier status.
events.current_status: NEGOTIATIONS MATERIAL; IMPLEMENTED FINAL CONTROL/REVENUE TERMS NOT YET INDEPENDENTLY ESTABLISHED

revision_history.change: Added as Aug. 26 append-only negotiation-status update; preserves Reuters/AP difference in finality.

events.summary: Kpler preliminary data showed five commodity-vessel Hormuz transits on Tuesday, Aug. 25, versus a 10-day average of 15; Monday had four.
events.observed_fact: Reuters reported Kpler's preliminary count of five commodity-vessel transits Tuesday: two LPG tankers, one bitumen tanker exiting, and two empty product tankers entering.
events.verified_effect: Visible commodity traffic remained substantially below the recent 10-day average despite diplomatic movement.
events.counterevidence: Actual totals may differ because some vessels switch off transponders; the count is not proof of total physical traffic.
events.continuity_evidence: Consistent with the Aug. 25 late overlay showing continued severe depression in visible Hormuz traffic.
events.current_status: TRAFFIC REMAINS WELL BELOW RECENT AVERAGE

revision_history.change: Added on Aug. 26 using Aug. 25 occurrence date rather than publication date.

events.target: Iran-blacklisted vessels and Gulf shuttle/STS shipping
events.summary: Iran listed 45 ships it says violated its Hormuz rules; Reuters sources said at least three Indian refiners and one global energy major planned to avoid blacklisted vessels.
events.observed_fact: Reuters reported the blacklist and the stated avoidance plans by multiple energy buyers.
events.claimed_effect: Iran threatened penalties including fines, detention and cargo seizure for listed vessels.
events.verified_effect: The blacklist is already influencing commercial vessel-selection behavior even without a reported seizure of each listed ship.
events.counterevidence: Industry adaptation may shift cargoes to alternate vessels rather than stop trade entirely.
events.continuity_evidence: Shows Iranian maritime coercion generating market friction beyond direct kinetic attacks.
events.current_status: BLACKLIST HAS MARKET EFFECT; ENFORCEMENT EXTENT UNRESOLVED

revision_history.change: Added as Aug. 26 append-only maritime-coercion/market-effect update.

location.name: Gulf of Oman / outside Hormuz STS area

events.summary: QatarEnergy issued its first crude tender offering ship-to-ship delivery outside Hormuz, joining other Gulf producers adapting export logistics around the chokepoint.
events.observed_fact: Reuters reported QatarEnergy's tender for al-Shaheen and Qatar Marine crude using ship-to-ship transfers outside the Strait.
events.verified_effect: A concrete commercial workaround is being offered outside Hormuz.
events.counterevidence: A tender is not proof that equivalent prewar export volume has been restored or that the Strait is commercially normalized.
events.continuity_evidence: Extends the broader Gulf shift toward shuttle/STS arrangements outside Hormuz.
events.current_status: ALTERNATIVE EXPORT LOGISTICS EXPANDING; CAPACITY SUBSTITUTION INCOMPLETE

revision_history.change: Added as Aug. 26 append-only energy-logistics adaptation update.
